text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Tottenham and Liverpool at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium!
Spurs are flying high under Ange Postecoglou so far, making an unbeaten start to their Premier League season so far.
They've won four and drawn two of their matches in the competition and came from behind twice last time out to earn a 2-2 draw against Arsenal in the North London derby.

Three points here would lift them above Liverpool, but that means doing something they've only managed once in the last 21 meetings between these sides, and that win came back in October 2017 (4-1), though it was at home.
Liverpool are yet to lose in all competitions so far this season, winning all seven of their outings since an opening day draw with Chelsea.

They've won their last four on the bounce by a 3-1 scoreline and had to come from behind for the fifth time already this campaign to knock Leicester City out of the EFL Cup when they met on Wednesday.
A win here today would take the Reds to the top of the table after Manchester City's loss earlier on.
Postecoglou makes just one change from the draw with Arsenal on Sunday.
Brennan Johnson picked up a hamstring injury in that game, so he's out today.
Richarlison replaces him, while Maddison is fit to retain his place despite being forced off with a knee injury last time out.
After making a lot of changes in midweek against Leicester, Klopp names almost the same side that beat West Ham last weekend.
There's just one alteration from that line-up as Gakpo replaces Nunez, who starts on the bench.
Alexander-Arnold is also among the substitutes after returning from a hamstring injury.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Szoboszlai gets the game under way for Liverpool!
Richarlison clips a cross in from the right which Matip just about manages to get away.
Spurs quickly win it back, with Bissouma looking to clip it over the top for Son, but Van Dijk cuts that one out.
Van Dijk goes for the big switch out to Salah on the right, and the Egyptian gets the better of Udogie.
He fizzes a squared pass to Szoboszlai on the edge of the box, but his first-time shot is deflected wide.
Udogie gets the ball in his own half, and makes a good run down the left, holding off Szoboszlai along the way.
He tries to pull it back from the byline, but it rolled out before he played the cross.
Liverpool have scored at least once in each of their last 15 Premier League games against Spurs.
However, they've only kept two clean sheets in that run, with both sides finding the net in each of the last six meetings between them.
Both sides are struggling to keep hold of the ball at the moment.
Salah's driving run is cut out by Romero's sliding challenge, and Maddison and Gakpo get in a tangle as they both try to get onto it.
CHANCE! Maddison quickly switches play out to Richarlison, who has acres of space down the left.
He fizzes a dangerous low ball across the face of goal which Alisson leaves, and luckily for him, nobody is there for Spurs.
DOUBLE SAVE! It's switched out to Diaz on the left, and he touches it into Robertson, who picks out Gakpo.
He's off-balance and takes a shot before hitting the shot which Vicario gets behind.
Robertson follows up with a volley, but the keeper denies him too.
Spurs' high press is causing some nerves amongst Liverpool's backline.
Alisson rushes a pass out to Matip, who has to stretch to stop Richarlison from winning it back high upfield.
Spurs think they should have a free-kick for a handball against Van Dijk, but they get a corner instead.
Maddison goes over to take it, but Mac Allister deals with it at the near post.
BLOCK! Salah threads it forward for Szoboszlai and he hits his cross between the two Liverpool players in the box.
Jones makes a late run in support and takes a touch before hitting a shot, but it's deflected wide.
Liverpool are keeping Spurs penned back in their own half at the moment.
Robertson's throw-in to Diaz is flicked onto Salah on the edge of the box, but he sends his shot sailing high and wide.
Spurs are keeping possession well at the moment, but it's all in front of Liverpool.
They can't seem to find any space to get over the halfway line.
Jones is shown a yellow card for a late tackle on Bissouma, but VAR is having a look at this for a possible red card for serious foul play.
It's a really poor tackle high on his ankle, and the youngster could be in trouble here.
JONES IS SENT OFF! The referee is called over to the monitor to have another look at the incident himself.
It's obvious that Jones wasn't intentionally trying to hurt Bissouma, but he went over the top of the ball and caught him high with studs.
The original yellow card decision is overturned, and Liverpool are down to 10!
Bissouma is now back on his feet, but moving gingerly as he limps to the sidelines with the physio.
It looks like he's going to try and carry on.
SAVE! Spurs' confidence is up and they're moving it upfield with a new found intensity.
Maddison gets it on the edge of the D, and uses Van Dijk as a shield to curl it on goal, but Alisson stretches to hold it.
Liverpool are scrambling to keep the ball out of their box, and Spurs are upping the pressure once more.
They put in a couple of crosses from the right which are cleared, but it keeps going back out to them.
GOOD CHANCE! Since they're having no luck down the right, Spurs switch it out to Richarlison on the far side.
He has space and cuts inside before lifting a shot over Alisson, but it keeps rising over the bar.
NO GOAL! It's good work from Salah on the right, as he outmuscles Kulusevski to slide the ball through the middle to Diaz.
He gets goalside of Van de Ven and fizzes a low shot across goal, but as he runs off in celebration, he sees the offside flag go up.

SON SCORES! Liverpool have been all over the place at the back since going a man down, and Spurs punish them for it! Maddison picks out Richarlison's run down the left once more and he unselfishly squares it into the middle for Son.
Alisson was drawn to the ball, leaving the Spurs captain to tap it into the empty net.

events.action: tap it into the empty net

text: 1-0 Spurs!
Richarlison has been afforded a lot of space down the left in this game, and this time, Liverpool are caught out by it as he picks out the perfect pass.
Gomez darts into the box to get on the end of Salah's throughball, and he goes down under pressure from Van de Ven.
It did look like he was waiting for the contact, and the referee only points for a corner.
Mac Allister blocks off Son's run before stretching to dispossess Udogie.
He gets nowhere near the ball, stepping on the left-back's foot instead, and he goes into the book.
SAVE! Kulusevski squares it to Son, and he tries to return the favour to Richarlison by teeing him up.
He takes too long to pick out a shot, and then tries to chip it over Matip, but Alisson comfortably gets a hand to it.
OFF THE POST! Liverpool are all over the place at the back.
Udogie pulls it back to Son from the byline, and he touches it into Kulusevski.
It gets away from him, so Richarlison takes over, but his low shot strikes the far post.
Gomez's legs are taken out from under him by Richarlison, and Liverpool win a free-kick on the right.
Szoboszlai swings it in, but Sarr heads it clear for the hosts.
Spurs break quickly on the counter, with Son leading the charge down the left.
Maddison is getting up in support, and it looks like the South Korean is trying to pick him out.
The cross is too heavy though, and Alisson collects.
Udogie tries to pull out of a challenge when the ball gets away from him, but in doing so, he catches Gakpo's ankle under his leg.
He's shown a yellow card.
GAKPO EQUALISES! Mac Allister pings it out to Szoboszlai on the right, and he curls a lovely cross into the far post.
Van Dijk nods it down and it bounces behind Gakpo, but he controls it before hitting it on the half-turn.
Vicario does get fingertips to it, but the power takes the shot straight into the back of the net.
Van Dijk was completely free as he peeled away to get on the end of Szoboszlai's cross and nods it down into a good area.
Gakpo went down as soon as the ball hit the back of the net, and it looks like his ankle is causing him a problem after being caught by Udogie earlier.
He can carry on after treatment.
GREAT CHANCE! Liverpool almost take a lead into half-time! Porro drops off, allowing Salah to carry the ball towards the edge of the box and he pokes it towards the far post.
Diaz is stretching, and he can only poke it wide.
HALF-TIME: TOTTENHAM 1-1 LIVERPOOL.
10-man Liverpool equalise in stoppage time to make it 1-1 with Spurs at the break.
The Reds started brightly, with Gakpo and Robertson forcing Vicario into an early double save.
The game was flipped on its head when VAR chose to upgrade a yellow card to red for Jones after a high tackle on Bissouma in the 26th minute.
Spurs took the lead through Son just 10 minutes later, but Gakpo equalised just before half-time to set up an interesting second half.
Postecoglou's side struggled to get at Liverpool early on, but after the red card, used their advantage well to break the deadlock.
He'll be hoping they can do it again in the second half.
Liverpool will take confidence from how they responded to going a man and goal down, but Klopp will be looking for ways to keep his front three in this game as it goes on.
Gakpo still looked uncomfortable as he went off for half-time after picking up an ankle problem.
He's replaced by Jota.
Spurs get us back underway for the second half!
Spurs are keeping Liverpool penned back in their own half early on here, but they can't get into the box.
Maddison and Richarlison both see crosses cleared, and Salah can't break on the counter.
GREAT SAVE! Romero pulls it back to Maddison just outside the box and he curls a lovely shot between two Liverpool players towards the far post.
Alisson is at full stretch and tips it wide.
ALISSON SAVES AGAIN! Liverpool just can't clear their lines, and it's clipped into Son in the middle of the box.
He chests it down before volleying a shot on goal, and the keeper has to push this one over his bar.

Only Jamie Vardy (five between February 2016 and December 2017) has scored in more successive Premier League games against Liverpool than Son, who has now scored in his last four appearances against them.
Mac Allister wins a free-kick on the halfway line and Szoboszlai tries to take it quickly.
Salah isn't quite on the same wavelength though, and Spurs win it back.
Liverpool can't make anything of their free-kick near the corner flag and Son bursts forward on the counter down the left.
Liverpool are scrambling back into their shape, but Sarr's shot is straight at Alisson.
NO GOAL! Maddison spins away from Mac Allister before sliding a lovely ball through Liverpool's defence to pick out Richarlison.
He pulls it back to Son again, and he guides it into the net, but the flag is up against the Brazilian.
It's another good attack from Spurs down the left, and this time, Son is looking to turn provider.
He pulls it back from the byline towards Porro, but Alisson manages to cut it out.
Richarlison is causing some real problems down Spurs' left and he gets a yard on Van Dijk once more.
He pulls it back into the middle, but this time, there's no one there for the hosts.
Salah is leading a solo charge upfield, but he gets in a tangle with Udogie, who does well to track back.
The defender goes down softly, but then the Egyptian kicks the ball away in frustration which earns him a booking for dissent.
There are a couple of fouls creeping into play now.
There's no real rhythm to the game as both sides keep breaking up play before any real possession can be developed.
Udogie is getting away from Jota, who just sticks out a leg to clip him from behind.
He's the latest player to pick up a booking.
Spurs are making their first change of the game now.
The goalscorer, Son, is replaced by Solomon.
JOTA IS SENT OFF! Liverpool are now down to nine men! Udogie picks the forward's pocket, and Jota lunges in to try and make up for losing possession.
He completely misses the ball but clips the player, and just over a minute after picking up his first booking, he gets a second.
Maddison is urging the fans to raise the volume as Spurs win another corner.
Liverpool manage to get this one away, but their task is only going to get harder from here as the hosts quickly win it back once more.
Liverpool are making a triple defensive change as Klopp looks to try and see out this draw.
Diaz is the first to go off, with Endo on for him.
And Salah is the last to go off, with Alexander-Arnold on in his place.
Gomez is also taken off, with Konate on for him.
Liverpool win a corner, and it's swung into the near post where Van Dijk gets in front of his marker.
He volleys a shot towards goal, but he can't direct it on target.
Liverpool have had three red cards in their last six Premier League games, which is as many as their previous 168 beforehand.
It's patient play from Spurs as they try to draw the nine men of Liverpool out of their own box.
Solomon catches Alexander-Arnold out as he cuts inside and tries to curl it inside the far post, but he sends it just wide.
The final change for Liverpool sees Gravenberch come on in place of Mac Allister.
There are shouts from the home fans for a penalty as Kulusevski goes down in the box.
He skipped past Alexander-Arnold before jinking past Gravenberch, whose leg was outstretched, but no contact was made.
Spurs are making a double change now.
Udogie is the first to go off, with Davies replacing him.
And Skipp is also brought on in place of Sarr.
Spurs are still dominating possession here, but are struggling to break Liverpool down.
Maddison tries to catch them out by curling an early cross into the box, but Matip heads it clear.
Robertson just caught Porro with his elbow during an aerial challenge and goes into the referee's book.
Bissouma holds Endo off by putting a hand to the midfielder's face.
He can have no complaints with that booking.
The yellow card is out again, this time for Romero who blocks off Szoboszlai's run when he tries to break on the counter.
Spurs are making a double change as they continue to search for a late winner.
Maddison is the first to go off, with Veliz on for him.
And Hojbjerg is also on in place of Bissouma.
Solomon gets in front of Alexander-Arnold on the left and curls a lovely cross into the middle.
Kulusevski is waiting for it, but Alisson wants it more as he rushes out to push it away.
Spurs are switching it from left to right, trying to open up space in behind Liverpool.
Kulusevski looks to curl it into the far post but gets too much on it and it sends straight out of play.
There's another yellow card here, this time for Van Dijk, who is deemed to be time-wasting.
OWN GOAL! Spurs have won it at the death! Romero spots Porro's unmarked run down the right, and the Spaniard fizzes a low cross in early when he sees Robertson closing him down.
Matip knows that Skipp is rushing in behind him and sticks out a leg to block it, but inadvertently turns the ball into the back of his own net instead.
2-1 Spurs!
The Spurs players rushed to the stands to celebrate that goal, and Porro's celebration is deemed to be excessive.
Veliz also goes into the book for time-wasting.
FULL-TIME: TOTTENHAM 2-1 LIVERPOOL.
Matip's last-minute own goal sees Spurs snatch a dramatic 2-1 win over nine-man Liverpool.
The Reds started the game brightly, only to go down to 10 men after 26 minutes when Jones' yellow card was upgraded to red for a high tackle.
Diaz then had a goal ruled out for a tight offside before Son slotted Spurs' opener into the back of an empty net.
Gakpo pulled Liverpool level just before the break with a fine goal.
Son thought he'd scored his second of the game, but was also denied by the flag.
Jota came off the bench in the second half, but two yellow cards in as many minutes saw him sent off too.
Liverpool defended staunchly, but Matip put the ball into his own net in the 96th minute trying to block Porro's cross.
Spurs' unbeaten start to the season continues, and that win lifts them into second, just one point behind leaders Manchester City.
Next up for them is Luton Town away.
Liverpool's own unbeaten streak comes to an end as they drop to fourth.
They now turn their attention to the Europa League and Union Saint-Gilloise on Thursday.
That's all for today, goodbye!
